sex.evidence: Experiments were performed on male Sprague-Dawley rats (220-260 g)

dosing.evidence: the 5-HT2A receptor agonist DOI ((2,5-dimethoxy-4-idophenyl)-2-aminopropane hydrochloride, 0.1 µg/µl, 1 µg/µl, 10 µg/µl)... DOI was injected into the VLO contralateral to formalin-injected paw.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were group-housed in a room with controlled ambient temperature

assays.assay_name: Von Frey filament test (secondary mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia)
assays.assay_description: Rats placed in testing cages with wire mesh bottom, acclimated 30 min. Two von Frey filaments (10 mN for allodynia, 250 mN for hyperalgesia) applied 10 times at the base of the third toe on plantar surface on both paws; three trials averaged. Tested 6 days after formalin injection following intra-VLO microinjection of DOI ± antagonists/inhibitors (ketanserin, U73122, chelerythrine, kynurenic acid) or GABA in vlPAG.

application_type.evidence: a 1.0 µl microsyringe... was inserted to the VLO through the guide cannula (intracerebral microinjection)

setup_habituation.evidence: rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom and allowed to acclimate for 30 min

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom

food_restriction.evidence: Rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom (no food in apparatus)

water_restriction.evidence: Rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom (no water in apparatus)

time_to_assay.evidence: rats were then lightly anesthetized with enflurane... DOI was injected into the VLO... drugs were... slowly infused... over a 1 min period (testing followed microinjection within the same session)

sample_size.evidence: Data are expressed as the mean (n = 6) ± SEM

outcomes.summary: Intra-VLO microinjection of DOI (0.1, 1, 10 µg/µl) reduced 1% formalin-induced secondary mechanical allodynia (10 mN) and hyperalgesia (250 mN) in the ipsilateral, but not contralateral, paw, without dose dependence. The antinociceptive effect was blocked by ketanserin (5-HT2A antagonist), U73122 (PLC inhibitor), chelerythrine (PKC inhibitor), and kynurenic acid (glutamate receptor antagonist) in the VLO, and by GABA in the vlPAG.
outcomes.evidence: microinjection of various doses of DOI (0.1 µg/µl, 1 µg/µl, 10 µg/µl; 0.5 µl), a 5-HT2A receptor agonist, into the VLO reversed the development of secondary mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia induced by 1% formalin in the ipsilateral paw (P<0.01), but there is no dose-dependent.

B1_num_measures.evidence: paw withdrawal responses to the applications of von Frey filaments (10 [allodynia] and 250 mN [hyperalgesia]) to the plantar surface of rat paws (ipsilateral and contralateral)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Three trials were completed to get an average of the number of paw withdrawal responses

B4_ethological.evidence: paw withdrawal responses to von Frey filaments

B6_cognitive.evidence: reflexive paw withdrawal; no learning or memory component

B7_automated_classification.evidence: experimenter was blind to the treatment conditions of each animal (manual scoring)

E1_environment_type.evidence: testing cages with a wire mesh bottom

E2_shelter.evidence: testing cages with a wire mesh bottom

E6_spatial.evidence: testing cages with a wire mesh bottom

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed in testing cages

E8_food_water.evidence: testing cages with wire mesh bottom; no food/water in apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: paw withdrawal... responses... before (Pre) and after DOI injection (Post)

D2_session_duration.evidence: Two von Frey filaments... were applied 10 times in each testing set... Three trials were completed (short reflex test)

D3_recording_days.evidence: before (Pre) and after DOI injection (Post); sixth day was chosen to evaluate nociceptive behaviors

D4_baseline.evidence: paw withdrawal... responses... before (Pre) and after DOI injection (Post)

D6_circadian.evidence: short reflex test, no session >=6 h

assays.assay_description: 60 × 60 × 40 cm arena divided into center (40 × 40 cm) and periphery. Rats placed in central arena, freely explored for 10 min. Center arena time and total distance traveled recorded. Used to verify catheterization did not impair motor function.

application_type.evidence: VLO catheterization; OFT used as control assay for catheterization effects (no DOI administered for this assay per se)

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were gently placed in the central arena and allowed to freely explore for 10 min

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: OFT arena with no food source

water_restriction.evidence: OFT arena with no water source

outcomes.summary: Surgical procedure and catheterization did not impair general motor function: no significant difference in OFT performance between naïve and catheterized rats.
outcomes.evidence: open field test: t = 0.1202, df = 17, P = 0.9057

B1_num_measures.evidence: The center arena time and the total distance traveled by the animals were recorded

B4_ethological.evidence: only center time and distance traveled measured

E6_spatial.evidence: arena divided into the center... and the periphery (virtual zones in single open space)

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were gently placed in the central arena

D1_continuity.evidence: allowed to freely explore for 10 min

assays.assay_description: Accelerating rotarod (5 to 40 rpm over 300 s). Latency to fall automatically recorded; three trials averaged. Used to verify catheterization did not impair motor function.

application_type.evidence: VLO catheterization; rotarod used as motor control assay

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed on an accelerating rotarod walking

outcomes.summary: Surgical procedure and catheterization did not impair motor function on the rotarod test (no significant difference between naïve and catheterized rats).

B1_num_measures.evidence: the latency was automatically recorded from the trial beginning to the mouse falling off

B7_automated_classification.evidence: latency was automatically recorded (beam-break/contact, not behavioural classification)

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were placed on an accelerating rotarod

D1_continuity.evidence: Three trails were conducted and the average latency were calculated

D2_session_duration.evidence: walking for 300 s from 5 rpm to 40 rpm

judge_notes: Only one candidate (glm) was provided; adopted its assay set with minor corrections.
Route for DOI set to 'other' (intra-VLO microinjection); the candidate's 'i.c.v.' label was incorrect (this is intracerebral parenchymal microinjection, not intracerebroventricular).
Set B1 for von Frey to score 1 (2-3 measures: 10 mN allodynia and 250 mN hyperalgesia withdrawal counts); candidate had marked it as score 2 erroneously.
Set D1 for von Frey to 'Multiple discrete sessions' since Pre and Post recordings are reported and compared.
Age scored as not_reported since only body weight (220-260 g) was provided, not age.
